hypothesis.claim: For matched, evidence-equivalent Koios.News drafts, contextualized versions meeting the declared editorial profile improve readers' predeclared factual-answer and uncertainty-recognition outcomes by at least 5 percentage points over concise versions; length alone is not the intervention.
hypothesis.falsifier: In a preregistered, adequately powered consented reader study, the upper confidence bound on the prespecified context-versus-concise improvement is below 5 percentage points, or an equivalently long padding-only control performs as well as the contextualized version under the same test conditions.
hypothesis.negativeControl: Include (1) source-accurate concise versions, which may already satisfy a reader need, and (2) length-matched non-contextual padding. Legacy publication dates and product-profile exceptions must be stratified, not treated as proven policy violations.
